Denied. Applicant is exempt from local Zoning Compliance under Under Section 335.02(4), Florida Statutes, County zoning regulations do not apply if the use is an FDOT-authorized service-plaza concession and forms part of the Turnpike transportation facility or its appurtenances. Section 335.02(4), Florida Statutes, states: (4) Notwithstanding any general law or special act, regulations of any county, municipality, or special district, including any instrumentality thereof, shall not apply to existing or future transportation facilities, or appurtenances thereto, on the State Highway System. Section 338.221(6), Florida Statutes, defines the Turnpike system to include its limited-access toll highways and associated feeder roads, structures, appurtenances, and rights. Section 338.234 expressly authorizes FDOT to contract or license private parties to sell food and accompanying nonalcoholic beverages on the Turnpike system. Read together, these provisions support treating an authorized restaurant serving service-plaza travelers as an appurtenance covered by section 335.02(4).

(Jimmy Jons}
